Synopsis:
    NextEra Energy secured a US DOE loan of up to $1.9bn to restart the 615 MW Duane Arnold nuclear plant in Iowa, closed since 2020, with operations targeting early 2029. The restart is contingent on NRC licensing and underpinned by a 25-year PPA with Google. The article contextualises this within a broader US push to revive mothballed nuclear capacity to meet surging electricity demand from AI data centres. Comparable US restart efforts (Palisades/Holtec, Three Mile Island/Constellation-Microsoft) are noted, all still pending or delayed.
